rules.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires a shot of any power, it must have a target that was scanned this very turn (age 0) and its gun must be pointing at that target to within 3.0°; if there is no target, a stale scan, or the gun is not aimed, it must not fire.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> ((obs.target matches Some(t) && t.age == 0) && aimed(*obs))

deleted_starters.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.

explanation.headline: Proved: the 1 rule holds
explanation.summary: Verus proved rule S2 (only fire at a robot seen this turn, with the gun aimed at it). The robot's code does nothing on every turn: it never fires, drives, or turns, so the rule holds trivially. Neither battle, in the open arena or the city map, showed any violations.
